name: Final Clue to Sanders' Treasure
summary: Along Westfall's coast, Captain Sanders' last directions point out to sea. A note in an old jug sends scavengers west toward his buried treasure.

sections.title: A Sailor's Parting Words
sections.body: Captain Sanders left his final directions in an old whiskey jug on the Westfall coast. The pirate had scattered cryptic notes along the shoreline, and this one completes the trail. From the jug, the directions lead due west into the ocean. Follow them through the surf to a lonely offshore rock, where his ironbound sea chest lies.

faq.q: What does the final clue say?
faq.answer: The note directs you west from the whiskey jug and out into the sea, where a small offshore island holds the treasure chest.

aliases: where do i find final clue
faq.answer: The clue was inside an old whiskey jug on the Westfall coast. It was the third step in Captain Sanders' trail of hints.
Captain Sanders was a pirate whose belongings and treasure maps washed up along Westfall's coast. Before his death, he left hidden notes and markers across the countryside that lead to his hoard.

faq.q: Where does this clue ultimately lead?
faq.answer: The note leads you west from Westfall's coast to a solitary island, where Captain Sanders' sea chest rests.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can follow Captain Sanders' directions out to sea and search Westfall's shores for treasure beyond Defias pockets.
